title: Summit Choice-Benefit Certificate Issue: Count and Expiry
content:
A Crestline Summit Loyalty Program choice-benefit certificate issue is computed as follows.

**Selection fulfilled.** The selection fulfilled is the latest selection of upgrade certificates on the membership.

**Count.** The issue carries the selection certificates: the upgrade certificates per selection of the tier the member holds, as the choice benefit entitlements set them, in whole certificates.

**Expiry.** The batch expires the tier's certificate validity months, in calendar months, after the day it is issued.

| Item | Taken from |
|---|---|
| Qualification year | The latest selection of upgrade certificates |
| Certificates | The tier's upgrade certificates per selection |
| Batch expiry | The day of issue plus the tier's certificate validity in calendar months |

**Hypothetical illustration.** With a certificate validity of 12 calendar months, a batch issued on 14 March 2026 expires on 14 March 2027.
